Hosted coverage workflow green at the candidate: cargo llvm-cov --branch (RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1 pinned 1.95.0) risk-module floors 90/90/80 native + wasm, Bun lcov floors 90/90, zero-branch-sites vacuity guard active, Bun pinned 1.3.14. artifactSha256 is the SHA-256 of the captured GitHub run-metadata snapshot.

Hosted test.yml FULLY GREEN at the candidate — every job in one clean run: the test matrix ({ubuntu,macos,windows} x Bun 1.3.14 — 1.3.9 dropped from the support surface for the WritableStream leak fixed in 1.3.14), the dedicated load job (load-addon, 20-session strict RSS gate, handshake bench, overload, load profiles), the per-push soak campaign (150-session small profile with periodic native-memory relief), Parity (W3C facade), WASM backend + Chromium interop, and the 9-lane exact-consumer Node matrix. artifactSha256 is the SHA-256 of the captured GitHub run-metadata snapshot.

Hosted IWA Direct Sockets proof green with candidate_commit pinned to this candidate (workflow checks out and asserts the exact SHA): signed-bundle app in real Chromium (pinned Playwright build) and Chrome Beta — datagram/bidi/uni echo, stop-sending code 41, reset code 37, reconnects, cert-rotation oldPinRejected. artifactSha256 is the SHA-256 of the captured GitHub run-metadata snapshot.

Independent 4-lane review round (architect, correctness-critic, security, test-evidence) over a389e81..33b9f31 — the entire unreviewed candidate range: the Bun<=1.3.13 WritableStream-leak root-cause fix (runtime floor 1.3.14, stream-retention falsifier), soak sampler committed-memory/heap-type instrumentation, the SOAK_COMMITTED_ABORT_MB breaker, the full 1.3.9 support-surface drop, the evidence-only rebind commit, and the trivy-action bump. Verdicts: ZERO P0 in every lane; 1 P1 (user-facing disclosure of the runtime leak hazard) and all distinct P2 (9), P3 (8), and P4 (~9) findings were fixed in commits 8498ddf, b2a1b82, 61e4c37, and 875dfbf and re-verified at this candidate by the full local gate set recorded alongside (packages 530+1skip/531 across 68 files, wasm 96/96, parity 71+71 zero-skip, playwright 21+7+1, doc-truth, tsc, soak-addon 23/23 including the new bunVersionAtLeast and aggregate-floor tests). Highlights: the committed-memory metric now GATES segment verdicts (it was forensics-only); the in-loop breaker flushes a partial artifact instead of throwing into an unawaited promise; aggregation refuses segments recorded on leaking runtimes; the stream-retention falsifier was hardened against vacuity and empirically re-verified to fail on Bun 1.3.9 and pass on 1.3.14; the library now warns once at runtime on leaking Bun versions because engines.bun is advisory. The security lane independently verified the trivy-action pin is the genuine v0.36.0 (annotated-tag SHA dereferencing to ed142fd, since repinned to the commit SHA per repo convention). Root-cause evidence for the underlying runtime leak (A/B repro, version bisect, 1.3.9 positive control with 45,831 live WritableStreams, 2h Bun-1.3.14 PASS verification) is preserved under docs/release-evidence/bun-writablestream-leak-2026-08-08/.

scopeLimits.summary: Hosted wasm Bun suite evidence is produced on the ubuntu wasm CI job; local darwin evidence is additionally bound under docs/release-evidence/ while Actions are unavailable, and does not expand the claimed support matrix.

docs/release-evidence/ directories other than the current candidate are named after commits that existed before the branch commit messages were aligned to the project format. Those SHAs no longer resolve in history; the artifacts are retained as a record of the runs, and no claim references them.
